manifestations.invariant: After setup day, revoking a permit releases its pitch to the ordered waitlist and records a credit entry exactly once.

contract_bindings.quote: The candidate choice follows ordered approval records for a released pitch.
Finance derives each remittance from the unused calendar proportion, then stores one credit entry.
